name: One Application that owns the platform, renderer, audio and game loop
body: application/Application.nox: create (SDL, window, platform, game loop), hand out a renderer and an audio output, run, shut down in order. ApplicationConfig gathers the environment variables. Programs.nox holds RunGame (a Nyx game) and RunStubGame, replacing runner/RunGame.nox and main.nox's own copy of the setup. FrameLoop is renamed GameLoop, with the Game interface in its own file.
